name: astril: GBM segmentation
desc: Stage 3a - segmentation inference (model training excluded) over a preprocessed NIfTI library, via astril's generic contract-driven segment CLI. Pick a registered model family from the dropdown (GBM_seg_v2 is the only one today; labels: 0=background, 1=necrosis/non-enhancing tumor, 2=edema/non-FLAIR hyperintensity, 3=enhancing tumor/tissue, 4=resection cavity), or pick an uploaded model directory (its own pipeline.json plus checkpoints) in the 'Custom model' field to run a self-trained model not published through astril's model manifest -- it takes precedence over the dropdown when selected. Stage 3b (quantify) runs automatically right after, using the segmentation_provenance.json sidecar this stage writes next to each exam's output -- disable with 'Skip automatic quantify' to correct masks manually before quantifying. Versions: astril-nf 0.1.0, astril 0.7.30.
